title: orthopogon velutinus
intro: Orthopogon velutinus, commonly known as 'Velvet Grass', is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. The health benefits of Orthopogon velutinus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Orthopogon velutinus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
